source: Ported from agent-lab .devcontainer/bootstrap-linux.sh (node, uv, gh, codex, claude) plus fresh 2026-09-22 fetches for qmd, mcporter, rtk, ai-memory, context-mode. Each archive was downloaded into a disposable worktree temp directory and hashed with sha256sum; npm entries were additionally cross-checked against `npm view <pkg> dist.integrity` (sha512, base64) computed with `openssl dgst -sha512 -binary | base64` over the same downloaded tarball -- all five matched exactly.

Verified against the release's .sha256 sidecar fetched 2026-09-22; matches the existing agent-lab devcontainer pin. Archive also contains uvx; install both.

v2.101.0 was GitHub's actual 'latest' release for cli/cli on 2026-09-22 (queried via `gh api repos/cli/cli/releases/latest`); hash verified against the release's gh_2.101.0_checksums.txt. Binary is at bin/gh inside the archive.

npm registry tarball for @openai/codex@0.160.0 (thin wrapper package, 4,902 bytes); the downloaded bytes match npm dist.integrity sha512-kEtVGzjRAYAMOwJxN39bGcna7LT3IDQgq64NNJ/dDTfu4OzZaocJcyNb5/gGJ/IVF/Vj7oK7E2m3nmTan7lpjg== and this row's SHA256. Registry signature and attestation metadata are present, but verification was not recorded for this promotion. A private-prefix npm install selected @openai/codex@0.160.0-linux-x64; its native binary SHA256 is 12eb3e81114588aca3b7998f4f19e8997b056aca08e57a7ca7c8a3ec8c652aad, matching the SDK's bundled binary. The coordinator recorded strict-hash SDK/CLI 0.160.0 installation facts and completed native-account SDK, gateway SDK and gateway CLI marker canaries (evidence/artifacts/runtime-sdk-20261003/receipt.json). The upstream scripts/install/install.sh and app-server-daemon/README.md at rust-v0.160.0, commit a956835d020762cb2b570053af06f643a11c0ecc, are unchanged from rust-v0.159.3. The portable Linux bootstrap supports `npm install --global --prefix tools/codex-0.160.0 <verified codex-0.160.0.tgz>` and relinks its bin entry; applying that bootstrap to an existing identity wrapper needs the host's serialized launcher ownership. The shared host launcher, daemon and production prefix still run 0.159.3 until a coordinated switch. The host's existing daemon_auto_start is enabled and its 0.159.3 daemon updater is disabled and pinned; adoption/templates/codex.config.template.toml remains an opt-in portable baseline with daemon_auto_start false. The earlier queue and Hindsight receipts qualify only 0.159.3; this 0.160.0 evidence is a same-host compatibility attempt with retained outputs and discriminating controls; original SDK invocation/source and process timing evidence is incomplete, so native_cli_e2e, new-host and model-quality acceptance remain unestablished. bootstrap-linux.sh verifies the platform_dependency archive by SHA-256/SHA-512 before npm install. ignore_scripts=true keeps lifecycle scripts disabled: the 0.160.0 wrapper and platform package have no scripts or dependencies. It requires the installed wrapper optionalDependencies alias to equal the pin, rejects unexpected nested/global packages, replaces only the contained Node-resolved package or a new contained alias, and checks package identity/version and the installed executable SHA-256. A fresh versioned tree is atomically published; failed unpublished trees are cleaned up and successful publication clears migration recovery before pruning. Pins that allow a rebuild must retain the complete verified platform tree byte for byte. A mismatch fails closed before publication.

tools.install_note: minimum version; native auto-update on the latest channel. Raised from 2.1.281 (56fe3da88458465fb27d7e9299dddb3fead55750fb9c2de795f233b5eea6dce1, that release's manifest.json platforms.linux-x64.checksum fetched 2026-09-24, size 237375560; its binary was not re-downloaded or re-hashed) in step with the macOS pin, since shared components keep one version on both platforms: 2.1.284 is the first release whose `sonnet` alias resolves to Sonnet 5.5 (`claude-sonnet-5-5`; CHANGELOG.md 2.1.284: "Added Claude Sonnet 5.5 (`claude-sonnet-5-5`), now the default Sonnet model on the Anthropic API"; https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config lists `sonnet` as Sonnet 5.5 from v2.1.284 and Sonnet 5 from v2.1.197, both read 2026-09-29), so an older client routes `sonnet` to Sonnet 5 on the Anthropic API; the 2.1.281 fix for a recursive rm of command-substitution output running unprompted in auto and --dangerously-skip-permissions mode stays included. This sha256 is the 2.1.284 manifest.json's platforms.linux-x64.checksum (https://downloads.claude.ai/claude-code-releases/2.1.284/manifest.json, fetched 2026-09-29: commit 2b8ce618c24de26410e4bdfc4e1d592accd61f61, buildDate 2026-09-28T02:36:51Z, size 243059896). First independent byte check, without a download: the 2.1.284 linux-x64 binary that Claude Code's own native updater had already installed on the NativeStack WSL2 host (~/.local/share/claude/versions/2.1.284, 243059896 bytes) re-hashes to the same digest (2026-09-29). Also re-hashed on 2026-09-29: the binary streamed from this pin's URL (HTTP 200, 243059896 bytes) hashes to the same digest. The manifest itself was verified with the documented procedure (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/setup#binary-integrity-and-code-signing) on 2026-09-29: the key at https://downloads.claude.ai/keys/claude-code.asc, imported into an empty keyring, has the documented fingerprint 31DD DE24 DDFA B679 F42D 7BD2 BAA9 29FF 1A7E CACE, and `gpg --verify manifest.json.sig manifest.json` reported `Good signature from "Anthropic Claude Code Release Signing <security@anthropic.com>"` (gpg's untrusted-key warning is expected; a copy of the manifest with one byte changed failed with BAD signature). The key's own certification, expiry and revocation were not checked, and the fingerprint comes from the same documentation. fetch() still verifies the served bytes against this sha256 before anything runs. Superseded the prior npm-wrapper pin (2.1.278, DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER=1) once the native installer became the reference path: fetch the binary, verify its sha256, then run `"$bin" install 2.1.284`, matching ~/codex-ecosystem/bin/bootstrap-linux.sh's own claude-code step. The installed binary self-manages ~/.local/share/claude/versions and the ~/.local/bin/claude launcher and auto-updates on the latest channel from there; this pin is a floor, not a ceiling: adoption/bootstrap-linux.sh's install_native (identical to bootstrap-macos.sh's since 2026-09-24) keeps a ~/.local/bin/claude whose --version already reports 2.1.284 or newer, logging `Kept installed claude-code <version>` with nothing downloaded or installed, and runs the checksum-verified install only when that launcher is missing, older or unreadable, so re-running the bootstrap never moves a newer auto-updated install back to this pin. No DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER opt-out is set.

version_probe.note: The pin is a floor: the native launcher auto-updates on the latest channel, so any version at or above the pin passes.

On nativestack-5975wx-20260925, 2.4.0 replaced 2.3.2 on 2026-09-25 and 2.4.1 replaced 2.4.0 on 2026-09-26, each after a rehearsal on restored copies and a cold-copy cutover (evidence/receipts/ai-memory-240-qualification-20260925.json and ai-memory-241-qualification-20260925.json); that is one host's state, not evidence about any other Linux host. Migrations are forward-only: 2.4.1 migrates a 2.3.2 store V64 -> V67 and a 2.4.0 store V66 -> V67 when `serve` first opens it, an older binary then refuses that store, and no automatic pre-migration archive is written for a 2.x store. On a host with an existing store, stop the service and take an at-rest copy of the data directory before the service restarts on this binary, then re-run `ai-memory install-hooks --apply` for each client (the hook commands name the versioned prefix).

2026-09-25 addition to complete the `token-efficiency` profile's Linux pin coverage. Upstream's pyproject.toml declares `version = "2.0.0.dev0"` with no corresponding PyPI release of that dev version (confirmed reading it at this commit, and the PyPI distribution name is `serena-agent`, not `serena`), so this pin is a source pin: an exact 40-hex commit on oraios/serena (confirmed present with `git cat-file -e c6fbd1c5932df2494ffa0020af5a9fbe80b82143^{commit}` and via the GitHub commits API, both 2026-09-25), not a downloaded-archive sha256. `sha256` is null; `tests/test_adoption_bootstrap.py`'s pin-hash test accepts a null sha256 here only because `kind` is `uv-tool-from-git` and `commit` is a verified 40-hex string -- every other kind still fails closed on a null sha256 exactly as before. The new `uv-tool-from-git` kind's `install_uv_tool_from_git` runs `uv tool install --python 3.13 git+https://github.com/oraios/serena@c6fbd1c5932df2494ffa0020af5a9fbe80b82143` -- the same commit and command already in adoption/bootstrap.md step 4a and recipes/README.md's `serena` row -- into the same `UV_TOOL_DIR`/`UV_TOOL_BIN_DIR` layout `install_uv_tool` uses, then reads back the resulting `uv-receipt.toml` and refuses (exit 1) unless it records this exact commit, so a stale prior install of a different revision can never pass silently. `serena --version` (a Click `is_eager` option that exits before any subcommand runs, confirmed reading src/serena/cli.py at this commit) printed exactly `Serena 2.0.0.dev0` with no `-<commit>` suffix from a fresh, non-editable install (its version helper in src/serena/__init__.py appends one only when its own installed directory is itself a git checkout, which a `uv tool install` from a git source is not); confirmed directly 2026-09-25 in an isolated `UV_TOOL_DIR`/`UV_TOOL_BIN_DIR` scratch install, not the shared host copy.

tools.install_note: Moved from 1.14.0 on 2026-09-27 (docs/decisions/2026-09-25-workstation-sota-refresh.md, the cutover update; evidence/receipts/socraticode-1150-qualification-20260927.json). AGPL-3.0-only; upstream commercial alternative. recipes/README.md's recipe is `npm install --global --prefix tools/socraticode-1.15.0 --ignore-scripts --before=2026-09-24T12:00:00Z socraticode@1.15.0`: `--before` reproduces the qualified dependency tree, because the package ships no shrinkwrap and later releases inside its dependency ranges (undici 6.29.0, @lumis-sh/wasm-eex 0.26.2) resolve without it. The bootstrap's `install_npm` installs this pin's verified tarball with `--ignore-scripts` (this pin's own `ignore_scripts: true` field) but passes no `--before`, so its dependency tree can differ from the qualified one. version_probe.note: No argument parsing at all: every invocation, --help and --version included, starts its MCP stdio server (dist/index.js never reads process.argv; observed 2026-09-25 with socraticode 1.14.0, matching the macOS pin's own note, and 1.15.0's dist/index.js still reads none), so the package version is read from npm metadata instead. Never run `socraticode --version` or with no arguments on a real install -- it starts the server.
